events.title: AI inference clusters may concentrate fast-ramping loads near substations
events.summary: Localized AI-driven load spikes could increase short-term substation stress and push immediate demand for higher-rated transformers or upgraded protection. Monitoring is needed to detect whether patterns are transient or structural.

events.title: Transmission congestion contributing to renewable curtailment risk
events.summary: If transmission reinforcement does not pace generation additions, curtailment could rise and shift investment demand toward storage and localized flexibility, potentially creating competition for limited equipment and materials.

events.title: Transformer manufacturing capacity mismatch with replacement demand
events.summary: Long lead times for large transformers may create project slippage and operational risk if demand clusters; early procurement and modular solutions could mitigate but may trade off performance characteristics.

events.title: Critical-minerals pressure could affect HV-equipment and transformer production
events.summary: Material supply pressure could lengthen equipment lead times and raise procurement costs; substitutions and recycling are possible mitigations but require technical validation and time.

events.title: Substation automation accelerates but raises integration and cyber risk
events.summary: Automation can reduce equipment failures if integrated properly, but rapid, fragmented rollouts could create interoperability and cyber vulnerabilities that delay benefits.

events.title: Battery storage procurement competing with substation upgrade needs
events.summary: Storage procurement can reduce near-term curtailment and provide services, but it may compete with capital for physical substation reinforcement, creating program-prioritization risk.

events.title: Fragmented interoperability requirements risk slowing HVDC and converter rollouts
events.summary: Standards fragmentation in HVDC and converter interfaces could increase engineering and commissioning overhead, slowing the pace of interconnection projects.

events.title: Capacity-market signal volatility could shift procurement timing
events.summary: Market signal volatility can cause clustered procurement behavior that amplifies equipment lead-time risk and creates price and schedule uncertainty in the supply chain.

events.title: AI-enabled predictive maintenance may reduce outages but increase integration complexity
events.summary: AI predictive maintenance offers reliability upside but introduces data and governance tasks that, if unaddressed, could limit benefits or create operational friction.

events.title: Procurement and interconnection policy shifts could change equipment specs and timelines
events.summary: Shifts in procurement or interconnection policy can re-route demand across the supply chain and may temporarily increase lead times or costs as specifications and approvals adjust.
